::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 26th 1865  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 77
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
Many thanks. Our letters have crossed but the enclosure was welcome in any way of having it.[^1]

I hope to finish [Abraham](organizations/other_177.qmd) today and send it

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: A [cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd) for £200.
